answer: Pay newcomers from one fixed pool per epoch, split among every account younger than 30 epochs, instead of a set amount each. A zephyr of a few honest arrivals barely dents anyone's share, but if a farmer floods in 10,000 fakes the pool doesn't grow, so each fake earns a ten-thousandth while still paying compute to answer. Like rain sinking into karst, the extra identities drain into one fixed basin. Faking only pays past the vertex of 30 epochs, and each fake must pass every one to get there.
